description: Holds each of the seven major currency pairs (EURUSD, USDJPY, GBPUSD, AUDUSD, USDCAD, USDCHF, NZDUSD) whose 12-month change is positive, equally weighted, monthly. Falsified if spot FX trends do not persist past a year. Backtested on FinzData FX daily closes (spot: the price change only, no interest differential), costs as stated, re-run free on full history.
title: FX majors trend · 12-month time-series momentum · 7 pairs (spot)
